title: React Component Generator
description: Generate React components with TypeScript support. Supports basic components, pages, layouts, forms, modals, cards, and context providers.

name.description: Name of the component (e.g., Button, UserCard, ProductList). Uses PascalCase naming conventions for React components.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this component?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where components are created (default: 'components' creates src/components/). For componentType 'page'/'layout', pass '*' to infer the route path from name instead (e.g. name=UserResourceFiles -> app/user/resource/files)

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for component creation

projectName.description: Target project name where component will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

componentType.description: Type of component: 'component' for basic React components, 'page' for Next.js pages, 'layout' for Next.js layouts, 'form' for form components, 'modal' for dialogs, 'card' for card containers, 'provider' for context providers, 'hook' for a generic reusable hook

x-prompt.message: Which component type would you like to generate?

items.label: Component - Basic client component with props and state
Page - Next.js page component with routing
Layout - Next.js layout component for shared structure
Card - Card container component for content grouping
Form - Form component with state management and validation
Provider - Context provider for state management
Hook - Generic reusable hook (use<Name>) in src/hooks/

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated component from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
